columns.name: ad_group_criterion_criterion_id
columns.comment: The ID of the criterion. This field is ignored for mutates.

columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.comment: The ID of the ad group.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.comment: The ID of the campaign.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: The ID of the customer.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_approval_status
columns.comment: Approval status of the criterion.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_effective_cpc_bid_micros
columns.comment: The effective CPC (cost-per-click) bid.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_effective_cpc_bid_source
columns.comment: Source of the effective CPC bid.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_effective_cpm_bid_micros
columns.comment: The effective CPM (cost-per-thousand viewable impressions) bid.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_final_mobile_urls
columns.comment: The list of possible final mobile URLs after all cross-domain redirects.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_final_url_suffix
columns.comment: URL template for appending params to final URL.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_final_urls
columns.comment: The list of possible final URLs after all cross-domain redirects for the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_keyword_match_type
columns.comment: The match type of the keyword.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_keyword_text
columns.comment: The text of the keyword (at most 80 characters and 10 words).

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_negative
columns.comment: Whether to target (`false`) or exclude (`true`) the criterion. This field is immutable. To switch a criterion from positive to negative, remove then re-add it.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_position_estimates_estimated_add_clicks_at_first_position_cpc
columns.comment: Estimate of how many clicks per week you might get by changing your keyword bid to the value in first_position_cpc_micros.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_position_estimates_estimated_add_cost_at_first_position_cpc
columns.comment: Estimate of how your cost per week might change when changing your keyword bid to the value in first_position_cpc_micros.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_position_estimates_first_page_cpc_micros
columns.comment: The estimate of the CPC bid required for ad to be shown on first page of search results.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_position_estimates_first_position_cpc_micros
columns.comment: The estimate of the CPC bid required for ad to be displayed in first position, at the top of the first page of search results.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_position_estimates_top_of_page_cpc_micros
columns.comment: The estimate of the CPC bid required for ad to be displayed at the top of the first page of search results.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_quality_info_creative_quality_score
columns.comment: The performance of the ad compared to other advertisers.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_quality_info_post_click_quality_score
columns.comment: The quality score of the landing page.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_quality_info_quality_score
columns.comment: The quality score. This field may not be populated if Google does not have enough information to determine a value.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_quality_info_search_predicted_ctr
columns.comment: The click-through rate compared to that of other advertisers.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_status
columns.comment: The status of the criterion.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_system_serving_status
columns.comment: Serving status of the criterion.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_topic_topic_constant
columns.comment: The Topic Constant resource name.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_tracking_url_template
columns.comment: The URL template for constructing a tracking URL.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_url_custom_parameters
columns.comment: The list of mappings used to substitute custom parameter tags in a `tracking_url_template`, `final_urls`, or `mobile_final_urls`.

columns.name: campaign_bidding_strategy
columns.comment: Portfolio bidding strategy used by campaign.

columns.name: campaign_bidding_strategy_type
columns.comment: The type of bidding strategy. A bidding strategy can be created by setting either the bidding scheme to create a standard bidding strategy or the `bidding_strategy` field to create a portfolio bidding strategy. This field is read-only.

columns.name: campaign_manual_cpc_enhanced_cpc_enabled
columns.comment: Whether bids are to be enhanced based on conversion optimizer data.

columns.name: campaign_percent_cpc_enhanced_cpc_enabled
columns.comment: Adjusts the bid for each auction upward or downward, depending on the likelihood of a conversion. Individual bids may exceed cpc_bid_ceiling_micros, but the average bid amount for a campaign should not.
